# Notes

Field notes from reading sessions. Each dated section below stands on its own,
so the notes can be collapsed one visit at a time.

## Monday

The morning session covered the nesting rules. A collapsed heading hides
everything under it, including deeper headings and their bodies.

### Morning observations

- Nested headings collapse with their parent.
- Expanding a parent reveals each child heading in turn.
- The chevron rotates to show the state.

#### Deep detail

This paragraph sits under a fourth-level heading. Collapse `Morning
observations` to hide it, or collapse `Monday` to hide the whole day.

## Tuesday

The afternoon session focused on reading long documents section by section.

### Afternoon observations

Collapsing every heading with `H` turns the document into an outline. Each
heading stays visible, which makes it easy to keep your place.

> Tip: expand everything again with `L` before using fragment links, although
> the reader also expands collapsed sections automatically when a link targets
> hidden content.

## Friday

The week wrapped up with a review of the toolbar controls next to the theme
picker.
